question.text: An HNI with Rs. 5 crore and a 20-year horizon seeks to beat inflation by 4% in real terms. If inflation averages 5%, the target nominal return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Source pp.16-17 distinguish real and nominal returns and explain that nominal return includes inflation compensation. Approximating, target nominal return = inflation + target real excess = 5% + 4% = 9%. The Trap: Confusing the real target (4%) with the nominal target (9%) or adding the figures in another way yields the other choices. Note: The simple addition is the approximate Fisher relation; an exact form would multiply (1 + real) by (1 + inflation).
